about_the_game:
The DLC offers plentiful supplies, including a coveted back attachment rumored to have emerged in the dungeon as adventurers sought better fortunes. Wear this skin proudly, and who knows—perhaps fate will smile upon you! After all, there’s no harm in trying!

Contained in the DLC:

- Back Attachment - [Resurrection Stone]

[Healing items]:
- Bandage x15
- Healing Potion x15

[Throwable Items]:
- Incendiary Flask x3
- Thunderclap Flask x3
- Stoneshaping Flask x3
- Smokescreen Flask x3
